newsitem.title: USA: Canadian domestic spot natgas holds in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian domestic spot natgas holds in light trade.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices remained firm in Alberta Tuesday as temperature highs in Calgary were forecast to top 80 degrees F on Wednesday, sources said.
Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub was quoted at C$1.47-1.48 per gigajoule, while August AECO rose by about one cent to C$1.46-1.465.
"Field receipts are just not there. I think producers may have overestimated what was available," one Calgary-based trader said.
He also said a minor interruption on NOVA's system near the Knight compressor station was having little effect on the market.
August-October AECO pricing was quoted at C$1.46, while one-year business was talked at C$1.67.
At Sumas, Wash., prices slipped another seven cents to about $0.98-1.00 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) in light trade.
In the East, prices at Niagara rose by about three cents to the low-to-mid $2.30s in response to the firm U.S. market, traders said.
